skill.name: gardener
skill.description: Maintains agent-flow context documentation, checks stale references, audits risk baselines, repairs verified claims, and converts recurring mistakes into enforceable repository controls.
skill.summary: Keeps agent-flow context files accurate, current, and aligned with repository code.
skill.author: drix10

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around paths, identifiers, and tool names. Two findings are confirmed because the skill directs agents to run an unpinned npx package and a git command with a repository-derived path.

remediation.issue: The npx instructions can download and execute an unpinned agent-flow package.
remediation.suggestion: Require a trusted pinned version or a locally installed binary, and use a no-install mode when possible.

remediation.issue: The git command includes a repository-derived path placeholder.
remediation.suggestion: Pass the path as a structured argument after the option terminator, without shell interpolation.

content.value_statement: Stale context files mislead agents and increase maintenance risk. Gardener verifies documentation against code, repairs references, and keeps risk baselines controlled.
actual_capabilities: Checks context schemas, referenced paths, timestamps, verification age, and unresolved placeholders.
Builds a documentation index using repository files and their latest commit dates.
Reviews risk-audit leads and proposes protected paths, risk boundaries, or known-surface acceptance.
Repairs stale documentation only after comparing each flagged claim with current code.
Runs a complete maintenance sequence covering synchronization, risk review, diagnosis, and repair.
Turns recurring review failures into proposed architecture, lint, hook, guard, or context controls.
limitations: The guarded role edits Markdown and the context manifest, but it does not modify source or configuration files.
Risk baseline updates and protected operations require human confirmation.
The skill depends on agent-flow tools or equivalent local commands.
It does not approve pull requests, merge changes, delete documentation, or accept secrets.

use_cases.title: Check Context Health
use_cases.description: Inspect context files for stale claims, missing references, invalid timestamps, and unresolved placeholders.

use_cases.title: Review Risk Baselines
use_cases.description: Evaluate new risk surfaces and prepare focused choices for human approval.

use_cases.title: Refresh Documentation Indexes
use_cases.description: Classify documentation as current, stale, missing, or archived using repository history.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Context Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the context health check. Report every failed check and provide the exact next command without changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Synchronize Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the documentation index from current repository files and commit dates. Show stale, missing, and archived entries before applying edits.

prompt_templates.title: Repair Stale Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Find stale context claims, verify each against current code, repair supported statements, update references, and rerun validation.

prompt_templates.title: Complete Repository Gardening
prompt_templates.prompt: Run synchronization, risk audit, diagnosis, and repair in order. Summarize fixes, required human decisions, and proposed enforcement mechanisms.

output_examples.input: Check whether our agent context is stale after the latest merge.
output_examples.output: Context health: two stale references found in AGENTS.md. No files changed. Next action: run the documentation repair workflow.

output_examples.input: Review new risk surfaces without accepting anything.
output: Protected path candidate: deployment credentials directory.
Risk boundary candidate: release automation scripts.
Human decision required before any baseline update.

output_examples.input: Repair the flagged documentation and verify it again.
output_examples.output: Updated verified claims and manifest references. The final context check passed, with one implementation issue opened for a missing lint rule.

best_practices: Review the code behind every flagged claim before changing documentation or timestamps.
Keep human approval for risk acceptance and protected write operations.
Run the final health check after every repair and explain any remaining failure.
anti_patterns: Do not refresh verification timestamps before validating claims against current code.
Do not accept secrets into a risk baseline or treat heuristic matches as final verdicts.
Do not delete superseded documentation, edit protected paths, or modify source code through this role.

faq.question: What files can Gardener edit?
faq.answer: Under the guarded role, it can edit Markdown files and CONTEXT_MANIFEST.json. Protected paths remain unavailable.

faq.question: Does Gardener change application code?
faq.answer: No. It opens an implementation issue when a fix requires source code, configuration, hooks, or refactoring.

faq.question: Can Gardener repair documentation automatically?
faq.answer: It can edit verified documentation, but stale repair certification and other protected operations require human confirmation.

faq.question: How does the risk audit work?
faq.answer: It treats detected patterns as leads, groups new surfaces, and asks a human to choose the appropriate response.

faq.question: What happens to outdated documents?
faq.answer: Gardener marks superseded documents as archived. It does not delete documentation.

faq.question: Can it run outside the Pi environment?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill provides agent-flow command alternatives, but the required package should be installed locally or pinned to a trusted version.
